rules.statement: Where an estate is enjoyed undividedly or otherwise by three brothers, two of whom being married to one wife, while the third brother has a separate wife: in the event of one of the friendly or associated brothers dying without issue, the other brother, with whom he had the joint wife, shall be his sole heir; the brother having a separate wife shall have no share of such demised brother's property of any kind.
